The '''''Scourge''''' was a [[Qektoth attack cruiser]] that was in use by the [[Qektoth Confederation]] as of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. It [[Battle of Qu'mock|fought]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' while in the [[Qu'mock system/Legends|Qu'mock system]]. The ''Scourge'' was defeated as the ship was unable to counter attacks from multiple fire arcs due to the design of the vessel's power generation system.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The fate of the ''Scourge'' is not explictedly stated. It is assumed to be defeated because the ''FarStar'' survives the encounter. Since it appears in a RPG adventure, this may have been done by the game designers to allow the gamesmaster to use the ship as a recurring threat to the players.
